'''Detoxify Poison in Another''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] which allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual to detoxify the [[Poison/Legends|poison]] in another's system, similar to the [[Detoxify Poison|ability]] that allowed a Force user to remove it from themselves. The process was made easier by the relationship between the two individuals, and the proximity between them.<ref name="RPG" />
